authored.context: Retail func_0023A5EC keeps an output-base pointer and initializes the output slot counter to zero before clearing output tables. Its first selected-index and count-byte stores use that counter, then increment it before the optional groups. The earlier partial output-pointer alias had a retail-sized frame but omitted the first-row marker.
authored.label: scenario-marker-output-pointer-counter
authored.observedEffect: Authenticated pinned-compiler watch emitted PURE_C at 2640 bytes/660 instructions with a 128-byte frame, no actual-only instructions and three expected-only instructions against retail 2652/663. The pointer-plus-marker control without indexed first stores was 2632/658 with the same frame and five expected-only instructions. Despite the closer extent, aligned symbolic differences remain 653 and the result is not linked exact.
authored.remainingFailure: Three instructions and broad register, opcode, address and scheduling differences remain. The owner is not active C and has no accepted relocation contract; a complete scenario wave verifier is premature. The exact ASM owner remains production.
authored.sourceChange: Combine the retail-observed first-row marker with the retained partial output-base alias; initialize output_count to zero before table setup, index the first selected and count stores through it, and increment it before optional groups.

boundary: Curated research observations; hashes authenticate inputs, not the authored effect claims or matching acceptance.
